notes.title: TFR Content Update - June 2021
notes.content:
The fourth content update has finally arrived! [b]V1.7.0[/b] offers a complete overhaul and re-design of the sound within The Forsaken Ruins, along with updates to existing UI, bug fixes, and added optimization. Players can now expect to feel fully immersed as they attempt to uncover the dark secrets of Ever-Bleed Keep. Furthermore, I have attempted to keep things clean and simple (UI-wise) in the hope that players find the new screens more appealing and easier to navigate. 

If you happen to chance upon any bugs within the game or, even have suggestions of your own, please don't hesitate to get in contact with me via the Steam or Tumblr page.

Thank you for your patience, once again! - Please note, I am currently working on other projects, so the time between updates may be longer than usual. Having said that, I still remain motivated on delivering the fifth, and final update to The Forsaken Ruins - Early Access Version. Cheers! ːsteammockingː

notes.title: One-Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
Once again, thank you for downloading and supporting the game! I can't believe it's almost been a year since I published my first ever game on Steam. I believe I have become a better developer since then and I hope you can continue to enjoy the updates I provide (even if they include the occasional bug!). I still remain motivated to continue development on The Forsaken Ruins with the hope I can look back on a well-rounded, story-driven, horror title. 

To celebrate 'The Forsaken Ruins: Early Access Edition' one year anniversary, I will be placing a [b]33% discount[/b] on the game, running from [b]May 27th to June 1st![/b]

Cheers again for the reviews, comments, and downloads! I take every opinion/suggestion into account as I want players to feel satisfied when they make a purchase. Be sure to check out my YouTube and Tumblr accounts for more information on upcoming updates. 😎

P.S - [b]The Sound/UI Update (V1.7.0)[/b] will be arriving very soon, sorry for the delay! ːsteamfacepalmː

notes.title: TFR Content Update - February 2021
notes.content:
The third content update has finally arrived! V1.6.4 includes a new Note System (along with 25+ new notes to read from), a new Player Journal, new loading screens, a new death animation/screen, fixes and polish [i](full list below)[/i]. This update is primarily about the writing - players can now expect to learn more about certain characters and monsters within the game, whilst uncovering the dark history of [b]Ever-Bleed Keep![/b]

If you happen to chance upon any bugs within the game or, even have suggestions of your own, please don't hesitate to get in contact with me via the Steam or Tumblr page.

Thank you for your patience - I underestimated how long writing would take me and I do hope you enjoy the new update. I am now focusing on re-designing the sound and menu screens. Thanks again! ːsteamhappyː

The decals do not tie into the current story (as of yet). In addition, the monsters will require further refinement, however as it stands, I feel at the very least, they are optimised.

If you happen to chance upon any bugs within the game or, even have suggestions of your own, please don't hesitate to get in contact with me via the Steam or Tumblr page.

I am now switching my attention towards notes/books within the game and I intend to share more details soon! Expect more updates in the future, as I attempt to iron out bugs and settle upon a strong foundation for the game. Thanks!

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content:
Thank you for downloading and supporting the game! TFR has now been graded by Solent University! And I am pleased to announce that the game did indeed pass! ːsteamhappyː

In addition, I wanted to take this time to announce my plans for future development. As of this moment I have started to delve deep into programming TFR once more. I am refining core mechanics and fixing the occasional bug that appears! I have ideas for puzzles and will be sharing more information on my Tumblr page.

Bug fixes and added content will either be listed on the message panel (within the game itself), or via the Steam page and Tumblr blog. 

Thanks again for the reviews, comments and downloads! Every opinion helps and keeps me motivated to work! I hope you are well during these trying times - it's best to stay indoors and play games ːsteammockingː - Jack
